behavior: Given a uniquely named disposable namespace and an opted-in workload that emits a unique marker with test.run_id, an authenticated get_failure_context call returns that marker plus namespace, pod, container, workload, observed timestamp, and the same test.run_id through MCP.
rationale: Only a Level-3 end-to-end scenario across the collector, ingest boundary, OpenSearch, and MCP can detect loss or distortion between independently deployed components.
